title: New at buying strollers: Chicco vs Combi
label: gear

posts.body: Hello, I'm 30 weeks along and my husband and I have been back and forth about these two brands of strollers for months now. We currently live in China, so lots of uneven ground. But we'll be in HK for the delivery and for at least 3 months later, so we're looking for something sturdy (good suspension) but also easy to carry around. We've been looking at the Chicco Enjoy fun and the Combi miracle turn premier. Any one have had experience with either or both? Could you shed some light on suspension, quality of wheels, longevity of use? Thanks!!

posts.body: I had the same problem except for us it was beaten chicco simplicity vs combi urban walker! In general chicco is more sturdy but heavier and bulkier and combi is easier to open and close and carry when child is not in the stroller... Chicco probably better for uneven ground but combi is easier if you take public transportation.... Hope this helps
